documents.title: Corporate Action-Fixes Record Date For Final Dividend For F.Y. 2025-26
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Disclosures under Reg. 29(1) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Vadilal Industries reported a 3% revenue growth in FY19, with international operations expanding by 54% and now accounting for over 25% of total revenue. Management noted that domestic performance was impacted by severe weather conditions in Q4, though they observed double-digit growth in the summer season of FY20. The company plans to continue investing in production capacity, brand building, and distribution while focusing on debt rationalization. Management expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore on capital expenditure during the year.

guidance.claim: Management expects to deliver double-digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.
guidance.quote: We also expect to deliver double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.

guidance.claim: Management expects FY20 to be another good year for the company.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we see another good year in FY20 as we leverage the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business growth was temporarily impacted by severe weather conditions in Q4.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

demand_outlook.claim: International revenue growth is driven by strong demand for ice creams within the Indian diaspora in the U.S. and other geographies.
demand_outlook.quote: International business is now over 25% of revenues and growth is driven by strong demand for our high quality ice creams and other products within the sizeable Indian diaspora community in the U.S. and some other geographies.

demand_outlook.claim: The company started FY20 with double-digit growth in the summer season.
demand_outlook.quote: We have started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is experiencing strong demand in international markets, particularly from the Indian diaspora.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues contributed 35% to the turnover during Q3, and crossed the Rs. 100 crore milestone in the first nine months, driven by deeper proliferation of Vadilal ice creams and processed food products within the Indian diaspora in the US and other key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business growth is reverting to historical trends after being temporarily impacted by changes in the operating environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects continued traction in the international business due to demand from the Indian diaspora.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues contributed 32% to the turnover during Q2 and continue to expand rapidly with Vadilal ice cream and processed foods products finding positive demand pull from the Indian diaspora in the US and other key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Management maintains a positive business outlook driven by a better environment for consumption and a shift to the organized sector.
demand_outlook.quote: Going forward, we maintain our positive business outlook – better environment for consumption, demand shift to the organized sector and continued traction in international business.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore on capital expenditure during the year.
capex_expansion.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company estimated capital expenditure for FY19 at approximately Rs. 35 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points in FY19 due to volume growth, benign raw material prices, and international operations.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year on the back of volume growth, benign raw material prices and larger contribution from international operations, where realizations are significantly higher.

margins_costs.claim: Management plans to increase prices in the second half of the year due to higher milk prices.
margins_costs.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have continued to expand – gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: The company has clear visibility of input costs for the upcoming summer season.
margins_costs.quote: Having already closed key supply arrangements for the upcoming summer season, we have clear visibility of input costs and expect strong contribution from sales.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin by over ~1,000 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Lower raw material procurement prices are expected to benefit margins.
margins_costs.quote: We have been engaging with raw material suppliers for the next season and prices continue to be subdued, which should benefit margins.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's production capacity is 380,000 liters per day.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years

orders_capacity.claim: Vadilal is present in 55,000 retail outlets across 26 states in India.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, we are present in 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states across the country.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that no major capital expenditure is anticipated on capacity enhancement.
orders_capacity.quote: No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

capital_allocation.claim: The company is focused on rationalizing debt and improving working capital management.
capital_allocation.quote: Leveraging surplus generated by operations to rationalize/ restructure debt and improve working capital management

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to risks such as regulatory changes and economic developments.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward- looking statements are subject to certain risks and uncertainties, like regulatory changes, local political or economic developments, and many other factors that could cause our actual results to differ materially from those contemplated by the relevant forward-looking statements.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore on capital expenditure during the year.
management_commitments.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

management_commitments.claim: Management will look to increase prices in the second half of the year.
management_commitments.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
